1479-2841-5235-8338.easyPrerequisites:
You're able to play a land this turn.
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Brokers Hideout.
1479-2841-5235-8338.description:
Fetch a land using Brokers Hideout.
When the fetched land enters, Shuttlecraft Galileo and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Shuttlecraft Galileo trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Shuttlecraft Galileo trigger from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Shuttlecraft Galileo triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

1778-5006-5256-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Memnite is starting in your graveyard.
1778-5006-5256-8170.description:
Cast Memnite by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Memnite spell. Then, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Memnite, causing a player to mill a number of cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-2301-3249-5268--52.easyPrerequisites:
Utopia Vow attached to Grimgrin.
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2301-3249-5268--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Utopia Vow by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Abzan Ascendancy triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

requires.n: Vehicle with MV >= 3 and a Crew Ability

5747-6243-8095--123.easyPrerequisites:
You have enough mana to cast the Vehicle with MV >= 3.
The number of artifacts you control is equal to or greater than the Vehicle's crew number minus 2.
5747-6243-8095--123.description:
Cast the Vehicle by paying its mana cost.
When the Vehicle enters the battlefield, Simulacrum Synthesizer triggers, creating a 0/0 Construct artifact creature token that gets +1/+1 for each artifact you control.
Activate the Vehicle's crew ability by tapping the Construct, causing the Vehicle to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the Vehicle.
When the Vehicle dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning the Vehicle from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not be an Angel because the Vehicle is no longer a creature and cannot gain creature types.
When the Vehicle enters the battlefield, Simulacrum Synthesizer triggers, creating a 0/0 Construct artifact creature token that gets +1/+1 for each artifact you control.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat from step 3.

270-1978-3430-5793.description:
Activate Hedron Archive by tapping it, adding six mana due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Hedron Archive which is an artifact creature due to Bello. 
Repeat any number of times.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-3899-6791-7824.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

1619-2921-4605-5542-6136.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-2921-4605-5542-6136.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Avenging Hunter from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Avenging Hunter enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Avenging Hunter.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Avenging Hunter that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Avenging Hunter token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Avenging Hunter token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Avenging Hunter that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Avenging Hunter trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-2921-4605-5542-6136.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

3532-5078-5957-6709.easyPrerequisites: Ballad of the Black Flag's fourth chapter ability has triggered this turn
3532-5078-5957-6709.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Kianne triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

4681-6542-6798-7747.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing Giant-Sized Flying Ant, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Giant-Sized Flying Ant from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Giant-Sized Flying Ant enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Repeat.

232-5778-6753-6867.description:
Cast Priest of Urabrask by paying its mana cost plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
When Priest of Urabrask enters, its innate ability and its offspring ability trigger.
Resolve the innate Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}
Resolve the offspring trigger, creating two token copies of Priest of Urabrask that are 1/1.
When the Priest of Urabrask tokens enter, they each trigger, adding six {R}.
Cast Appa by paying its mana cost plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
When Appa enters, its innate ability and its offspring ability trigger.
Resolve the innate Appa trigger, airbending the nontoken Priest of Urabrask.
Resolve the offspring trigger, creating two token copies of Appa that are 1/1.
Put both Appa tokens into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Both Appa tokens' enter-the-battlefield ability trigger, airbending Appa with one trigger and nothing with the other.
Cast Priest of Urabrask from exile by paying {2} plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
Repeat steps 2 through 5 once.
Cast Appa from exile by paying {2} plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
Repeat from step 7.
232-5778-6753-6867.notes: Once you have extra mana, other nonland permanents can be airbended using Appa and returned to the battlefield each loop as desired.

2724-3987-5775.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Fortune.
2724-3987-5775.description:
Blink Wormfang Manta using Fortune. Wormfang Manta's first ability won't trigger due to Torpor Orb.
Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

4125-4872-7631.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Echocasting Symposium's paradigm ability triggers, causing you to cast a copy of it from exile. 
Resolve the copy, creating a token copy of Shipwreck Dowser
When the Shipwreck Dowser token enters, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3375-4499-7494.description:
Cast a copy of Seething Song from exile by paying no more than {1}{R}, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Blazing Firesinger, which enters prepared.
Repeat.

2511-6553-7424.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Changing Loyalty triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Changing Loyalty from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Legend of Kyoshi // Avatar Kyoshi

215-3464-7066.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
215-3464-7066.description:
Activate Avatar Kyoshi by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Cast Hyrax Tower Scout by paying {2}{G}.
When Hyrax Tower Scout enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Avatar Kyoshi.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Hyrax Tower Scout from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2906-4217-7302.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost at least 2 life this turn.
2906-4217-7302.description:
Cast Whirlwind Technique by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target(s).
Holding priority, cast Lutri by paying its mana cost reduced by Rakdos.
When Lutri enters, it triggers, copying Whirlwind Technique targeting Lutri.
Resolve Whirlwind Technique, airbending Lutri.
Holding priority, cast Lutri from exile by paying {0} due to Rakdos.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-4689-7060.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4689-7060.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Otharri as attackers.
Otharri triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1171-1409-1879.description:
Activate Garth One-Eye by tapping it, casting a copy of Black Lotus by paying {0}.
Activate the Black Lotus token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Garth One-Eye by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Garth One-Eye enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Garth One-Eye.
Repeat.

3755-4871-5220-5686.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
3755-4871-5220-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

2511-4871-5220-6594.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
2511-4871-5220-6594.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1251-1563-3000-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

2034-4871-5497-6747-7147.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Hoverstone Pilgrim by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to Sami.
Repeat.

3459-5078-6723-6766.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

1879-2440-3581-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
Kykar triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Spirit you control.
Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Spirit token.
Activate the Spirit token by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature a returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
1879-2440-3581-7109.notes: The cost can be reduced to as little as {1} if you control other Spirits. You can also sacrifice the Spirits once you have enough to get infinite {R}.

5170-5231-6094-6132.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger.
Resolve the Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

3693-6919-7061.description:
Cast Strength of Will by paying {1}{G}, targeting Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to it.
Walking Ballista triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Solid Ground.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 2.
3693-6919-7061.notes: You can skip step 4 if desired.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2034-5663-6972.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Cayth.
When Cayth dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Cayth enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2275-3532-5078-5645.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Shabraz triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to gain 1 life.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

678-4210-5670.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
678-4210-5670.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
678-4210-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
When the creature dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, and Wayward Disciple triggers if it's on the battlefield.
Resolve the Wayward Disciple trigger, if applicable, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Pious Evangel triggers if it's on the battlefield, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

851-4636-5770-6441.description:
Activate Architect of the Untamed by paying eight {E}, creating four 6/6 Beast artifact creature tokens.
When the Beasts enter the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart triggers four times, causing you to get eight {E}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Valentin, Dean of the Vein // Lisette, Dean of the Root

1939-3097-5641.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1939-3097-5641.description:
Gain life.
Lisette triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield, Lunarch Veteran triggers if it's on the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Luminous Phantom triggers if it's on the battlefield.
Resolve the Lunarch Veteran // Luminous Phantom trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

372-864-3378.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Illusionist's Stratagem exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-864-3378.description:
Cast Illusionist's Stratagem by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Eternal Witness and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Eternal Witness trigger.
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Illusionist's Stratagem from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Illusionist's Stratagem.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Eternal Witness and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

2281-2732-5147.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Prowling Geistcatcher.
When Saffi dies, Prowling Geistcatcher's first ability triggers, exiling Saffi from your graveyard.
Resolve the Saffi ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Prowling Geistcatcher.
When Prowling Geistcatcher dies, its second ability and Saffi trigger.
Resolve the Saffi trigger, returning Prowling Geistcatcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Prowling Geistcatcher trigger, returning Saffi from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

141-413-5260.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-413-5260.description:
Cast Entering by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it and Blasting Station trigger, with Naru Meha targeting Entering.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Entering, with the copy targeting Naru Meha
Resolve the Entering copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
141-413-5260.notes: You can cast Breaking and Entering fused together to also get infinite mill and self-mill.

362-1482-2904.description:
Activate Jeweled Lotus's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Cephalid Illusionist.
Cephalid Illusionist triggers, causing you to mill three cards.
Resolve the Jeweled Lotus ability, attaching it to Cephalid Illusionist.
Repeat.

512-3576-5089.notablePrerequisites: Vedalken Engineer and Halo Fountain do not have summoning sickness.
512-3576-5089.description:
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing Halo Fountain to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Vedalken Engineer by tapping it, adding {W}{W} that can only be spent to cast artifact spells or activate abilities of artifacts.
Activate Halo Fountain's second ability by paying {W}{W}, tapping it and untapping Halo Fountain and Vedalken Engineer, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.
